neighbours.label: The first part of a compound that names an urban area (inner| city, meg|acity, In|nen|stadt, Peri|-Urban, down|town), where 'city/town' is the expected continuation; plain 'the city' or rural places stay quiet.
fire: Lagos is one of Africa's fastest-growing megacities.
Wir haben einen Spaziergang in die Innenstadt gemacht.
Peri-urban farms supply most of the vegetables.
The new tram line runs through the inner city.
Planners fear the rise of sprawling megacities.
Die Geschäfte in der Innenstadt schließen um acht.
Crime fell sharply in the inner suburbs.
quiet: Lagos is one of Africa's fastest-growing ports.
Wir haben einen Spaziergang in den Wald gemacht.
Small family farms supply most of the vegetables.
The new tram line runs through the old valley.
Planners fear the rise of sprawling farmland.
Die Geschäfte im Dorf schließen um acht.
Crime fell sharply in the countryside.

short: first part of an urban-area compound
notes: Card: ' la' (au-dessus de la ville), 'i' (Per⟦i⟧-Urban), 'nen' (In⟦nen⟧stadt), ' meg' (megacity), ' inner'; output (+ pole) suppresses ' town', ' camp', ' settlement', so the - pole favours them. Exploratory probe: megacity 0.67, inner city 0.35; 'over the city' 0.04, 'city centre' 0.03.
